title: Officer's Actions Lead to Serious Backlash
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

Officer Matthew Knutson, a 13-year veteran with the Green Bay Police department, is accused of misconduct in public office and negligent operation of a vehicle. He allegedly used his squad car to intentionally strike a man who was fleeing from the police in November 2021. The criminal complaint points out disparities between Knutson's report and the released video footage, indicating potential inaccuracies in his account of the incident. As of June 15, 2023, Knutson's attorney filed a motion to dismiss the charges. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
